quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #19
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: One lane ahead.
Merging traffic ahead.
Lane ends ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merging traffic ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks under 18,000 lbs. allowed.
Hill ahead.
Truck stop ahead.
No trucks allowed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up.

questions.question: Should you always drive slower than other traffic?

options.text: No, driving too slowly can block traffic.
Yes, it is good defensive driving.
Yes, it is always safer than driving faster.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, driving too slowly can block traffic.
questions.explanation: Drive slowly when there is heavy traffic or bad weather. However, driving too slowly and blocking normal traffic flow can result in a citation.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The divided highway is ending ahead.
A divided highway is starting ahead.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A divided highway is starting ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway begins ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: When exiting an expressway, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up on the exit ramp.
Check the speed limit for the road you are entering.
Cut off other traffic.
Do not use your turn signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check the speed limit for the road you are entering.
questions.explanation: Watch other traffic carefully when exiting. Look at the new speed limit and check your speedometer. The exit road usually has a lower speed limit than the expressway.

questions.question: Which of these commonly causes traffic accidents?

options.text: Not paying attention while driving
Speeding for the conditions
Following too closely behind other vehicles
All of the above

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above
questions.explanation: Speeding is a major cause of crashes. Not paying attention can cause collisions. Most rear-end crashes happen because drivers follow too closely.

questions.question: If your car has a bad suspension, it can cause:

options.text: Problems controlling your vehicle.
Squealing brakes.
Loose steering.

questions.correctAnswerText: Problems controlling your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Your suspension helps you control your vehicle and keeps your ride smooth on different road surfaces. If your car bounces a lot after hitting a bump or is hard to control, you may need new suspension parts.

questions.question: You have the right-of-way when:

options.text: You are entering a traffic circle.
You are backing out of a driveway.
You are leaving a parking space.
You are already inside a traffic circle.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are already inside a traffic circle.
questions.explanation: Drivers entering a traffic circle must yield to drivers already in it. Drivers leaving a driveway or parking space must yield to all traffic already on the road.

questions.question: What should you do if your right wheels leave the pavement?

options.text: Stop quickly.
Pull all the way off the road and get back on when safe.
Speed up and steer back on the road quickly.
Release the accelerator, slow down, then ease back onto the road when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Release the accelerator, slow down, then ease back onto the road when safe.
questions.explanation: Do not panic. Release the accelerator and steer parallel to the road. Slow down and ease back onto the road by keeping both hands on the wheel and turning slightly into the right lane. Check for traffic before steering back onto the pavement.

questions.question: Which of these affect how alcohol impacts your body?

options.text: How much food is in your stomach
Your body weight
How much time passes between drinks
All three of these

questions.correctAnswerText: All three of these
questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol level depends on how much you drink, the time between drinks, and your weight. Eating before or while drinking slows alcohol absorption somewhat, but it cannot prevent impairment if you drink too much.

questions.question: What does a steady green traffic light mean?

options.text: Speed up.
Adjust your mirrors.
You may go through the intersection at a safe speed if it is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may go through the intersection at a safe speed if it is clear.
questions.explanation: A steady green light means you can go. Watch for other traffic or pedestrians already in the intersection. Only proceed if the intersection is clear.

questions.question: When driving at night, you should:

options.text: Always use your high beams.
Look directly at the headlights of oncoming cars.
Stay farther behind other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther behind other cars.
questions.explanation: When it is dark, increase the distance between your car and the car ahead. Use your headlights properly. Do not look at the headlights of oncoming cars because the glare can blind you.

questions.question: On a multilane road, a dashed yellow line next to a solid yellow line means:

options.text: No one can pass in either direction.
Anyone can pass in either direction.
Only cars next to the dashed line can pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only cars next to the dashed line can pass.
questions.explanation: When there is a dashed line on one side and a solid line on the other, only cars next to the dashed line may cross the center line to pass. Cars next to the solid line cannot pass.

questions.question: What happens if you refuse to take a chemical test for drugs or alcohol?

options.text: There is no proof you were driving drunk.
You cannot be arrested for drunk driving.
Your license will be suspended or revoked.
None of these choices.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your license will be suspended or revoked.
questions.explanation: By driving, you agree to take a chemical test if arrested for a drug or alcohol violation. If you refuse, your license will be suspended right away. If a DMV hearing confirms you refused, your license will be revoked, even if you are found not guilty in court.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light works the same way as:

options.text: A slow sign.
A yield sign.
A stop sign.
An intersection sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop completely. Yield to all other traffic that does not have to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: School zone or crossing.
Pedestrian crossing.
Railroad ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or crossing.
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers about a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway:

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
Pass only on the right.
Watch for oncoming traffic.
You do not need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear and signal to show you are changing lanes.

questions.question: To help prevent crashes, you should:

options.text: Let other road users know what you are doing.
Ignore other drivers on the road.
Drive only on side streets and back roads.
Avoid driving during rush hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other road users know what you are doing.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers surprise other road users. Signal when you slow down, stop, or change direction. Use your emergency lights or horn when needed.

questions.question: When double solid yellow lines separate lanes of traffic:

options.text: You can pass on the left.
You can pass on the right.
You cannot pass in either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot pass in either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean traffic is moving in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed from either side.

questions.question: Roads are most slippery:

options.text: After it has been raining for several hours.
When rain first starts.
After it has been raining for one to two hours.

questions.correctAnswerText: When rain first starts.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery when it first starts to rain. Dirt and oil on the road mix with water, creating a slick surface.
